text: Chip Fields played Rochelle in "J.J.'s New Career (2)" (Season 4, Episode 8, first aired November 17, 1976), a guest role according to [TVMaze](https://www.tvmaze.com/characters/204646/good-times-rochelle) and [TheTVDB](https://thetvdb.com/series/good-times/episodes/238770).
